label: Quantum gravity
summary: Aziz and Howl describe the unification of gravity and quantum mechanics as an open scientific problem and discuss gravitationally mediated entanglement as a proposed experimental probe.

label: Classical gravity plus QFT entanglement
summary: Aziz and Howl propose that extending the treatment of matter to quantum field theory permits a classical gravitational interaction to transmit quantum information and generate entanglement. Gundhi, Infantino and Bassi dispute the gravitational interpretation of the reported entanglement, attributing it to particle diffusion and free evolution for the partition considered.

label: Entanglement scaling discriminator
summary: Aziz and Howl propose that their classical-gravity entanglement effect scales differently from the quantum-gravity effect they consider, affecting the experimental form and parameters needed to test gravity. Their interpretation of the entanglement mechanism has been challenged by Gundhi, Infantino and Bassi.
